name: PhoneInput
description: International phone field: country selector + formatted number input with field chrome.

ariaRequirements: error via HelperText linked with aria-describedby + aria-invalid
country select has its own accessible name from the library
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Promoted from alpha: Example + ForcedColors stories present; Storybook axe gate enabled.

forbiddenUse: bypass onChange and read the DOM input value; it is the display format, not the E.164 value.
dense: international phone field wrapping react-phone-number-input; flag + country select + formatted input, own label/error/helperText, defaultCountry FI, emits E.164 via onChange(value)

usage.description: PhoneInput wraps react-phone-number-input with the design-system field chrome: Label, error and helper wiring, and token-based styling over the library's country selector and input. It formats as you type and emits the E.164 value (or undefined while incomplete) through onChange. The default country is FI; override defaultCountry per audience.

bestPractices.description: Validate with isValidPhoneNumber from react-phone-number-input on submit; the field formats but does not block invalid numbers.
Store and send the emitted E.164 value verbatim; it is the interchange format your backend and SMS providers expect.
Set defaultCountry to the audience you actually serve; users typing a local number get the right prefix for free.
Treat onChange emitting undefined as "incomplete", not as an error; only validate on blur or submit.
Do not use TextInput type=tel for international audiences; you lose country selection and normalization.
Do not pre-split country code and number into two fields; the combined control is the accessible, error-proof pattern.

anatomy.description: @dt/Label tied to the input via htmlFor; shows the required marker and disabled dimming.
